Name: getVPPDispatchSummary
Body:
{ 
    // Get event details
    // let input_event_id = '31d833e1-be0c-44cf-a468-a84a4ab7f77f';  //'6efbe411-cc64-4d32-8448-f84071eaff9c';
    let evt = 
        silver_stream_dispatch_events
        | where event_id == input_event_id 
        | extend sites_array = parse_json(sites)
        | extend sites_str = array_strcat(sites_array, ",")
        | summarize arg_max(ingestion_time(),*) by event_id
    ;
    // evt;
    let evt_id = toscalar(evt | project event_id);
    let evt_start_time = toscalar(evt | project event_start_time);
    let evt_end_time = toscalar(evt | project event_end_time);
    let sites_str = toscalar(evt | project sites_str);// print sites_str;
    let sites_list = split(sites_str, ","); //print sites_list
    // Aggregate metrics from silverCommDataSite for the duration of the event
    let dispatch_summary = 
        database('EventHouse').table('silverCommDataSite') 
        | where siteId in~ (sites_list)
            and (sourceTimestamp >= evt_start_time and sourceTimestamp < evt_end_time)
            and battery_200_IncWhExp between (0 .. 7500)
        | summarize 
            load_200_W =  avg(load_200_W),
            pv_200_W = avg(pv_200_W), 
            battery_200_W = avg(battery_200_W), 
            battery_200_IncWhImp = sum(battery_200_IncWhImp),
            battery_200_IncWhExp = sum(battery_200_IncWhExp),
            grid_200_IncWhImp = sum(grid_200_IncWhImp),
            grid_200_IncWhExp = sum(grid_200_IncWhExp),
            count = count()
        by siteId, bin(sourceTimestamp, 15min)
        | summarize
            total_count = sum(count),
            distinct_site_count = count_distinct(siteId),
            load_power = sum(iff(isnan(load_200_W),0.0,load_200_W)),
            missing_load_power = countif(isnan( load_200_W)),
            pv_power = sum(iff(isnan(pv_200_W),0.0,pv_200_W)),
            missing_pv_power = countif(isnan( pv_200_W)),
            battery_power = sum(iff(isnan(battery_200_W),0.0,battery_200_W)),
            missing_batt_power = countif(isnan( battery_200_W)),
            sum_battery_200_IncWhImp = sum(battery_200_IncWhImp),
            sum_battery_200_IncWhExp = sum(battery_200_IncWhExp),
            sum_grid_200_IncWhImp = sum(grid_200_IncWhImp),
            sum_grid_200_IncWhExp = sum(grid_200_IncWhExp)
        by bin(sourceTimestamp, 15min)
        | order by sourceTimestamp asc
        | serialize
        | extend
            cum_sum_battery_energy_Imp = row_cumsum(sum_battery_200_IncWhImp),
            cum_sum_battery_energy_Exp = row_cumsum(sum_battery_200_IncWhExp),
            cum_sum_grid_energy_Imp = row_cumsum(sum_grid_200_IncWhImp),
            cum_sum_grid_energy_Exp = row_cumsum(sum_grid_200_IncWhExp)
    ;
    // Get Site Participation count from silver_site_dispatch_results table
    let dispatch_site_participation =
        silver_dispatch_result_dto
        | where event_id == evt_id
            and tolower(command) !contains "stop"
        | extend command = case(
            toupper(command) == 'DISCHARGE_TO_HOME_AND_GRID' or toupper(command) == 'DISCHARGE_TO_LOAD_GRID', 'discharge'
            ,toupper(command) == 'SELF_CONSUMPTION', 'self_consumption'
            ,toupper(command) == 'CHARGE_FROM_SOLAR' or toupper(command) == 'CHARGE_FROM_GRID_AND_SOLAR' or toupper(command) == 'CHARGE_FROM_PV_GRID', 'charge'
            ,''
        )
        | summarize sites_participation = count_distinct(site_id), overall_event_commands = min(command)
    ;
    // dispatch_site_participation;
    // Join dispatch_summary and dispatch_site_participation tables
    dispatch_summary
    | extend dummy = 1
    | join kind=leftouter (dispatch_site_participation | extend dummy = 1) on dummy
    | project 
        evt_id,
        evt_start_time,
        evt_end_time,
        command = overall_event_commands,
        ts_time = sourceTimestamp,
        energy_charged = cum_sum_battery_energy_Imp,
        energy_discharged = cum_sum_battery_energy_Exp,
        energy_imported = cum_sum_grid_energy_Imp,
        energy_exported = cum_sum_grid_energy_Exp,
        battery_power = round(battery_power,3),
        aggregate_load = round(load_power,3),
        aggregate_pv = round(pv_power,3),
        sites_participation,
        missing_power_count = max_of(missing_batt_power,missing_load_power,missing_pv_power)
}
